raw_segments.text: Let us consider for a moment what most of the trouble and anxiety which I have referred
to is about, and how much it is necessary that we be troubled, or, at least, careful.
It would be some advantage to live a primitive and frontier life, though in the midst of
an outward civilization, if only to learn what are the gross necessaries of life and
what methods have been taken to obtain them, or even to look over the old daybooks of the
stores, what they stored, that is, what are the grossest groceries?
